jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionPlain:
Example Health writes clinical notes from visit audio. Forward Deployed Engineers own a hospital rollout end to end.
You will build LLM agents and RAG over each customer's records in Python and TypeScript, write the evals that decide when a prototype is safe to ship, and connect our APIs to the hospital's systems on AWS.
You will spend about a third of your time with customers.
Example Health is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran or military status.
